# Full Cmod A7 GPIO: validation

Validated on 21 November 2026 in the full-GPIO update on `codex_cmod_a7`. The earlier eight-pin limit came from the wrapper's port list and `w_gpio=8`; the Cmod A7 exposes 44 digital DIP GPIOs. All four configurations now pass `w_gpio=44` and `lab_top.gpio[43:0]` with the same physical mapping.

With microphone, DAC and TM1638 enabled, **35 pins are free: DIP 1–14, 17–23 and 35–48**. Without TM1638, **38 pins are free**, including DIP 26–28. Disabling all three accessory interfaces releases all 44 pins for the lab. Leave enabled accessory bits at Z and disconnect an external module before reusing its pins. DIP 15/16 are separate analog connections; DIP 24/25 are supply/ground. Pmod remains assigned to TinyVGA.

The [English mapping](assembly_en.html#gpio) and [русская таблица](assembly_ru.html#gpio) list every bus range and the interface macros. All four XDC files preserve Digilent's original definitions, including its clock declaration; only required lines are uncommented. There are **62 constrained scalar top-level ports**, including the 44 digital DIP ports declared `inout`.

## Regression and documentation checks

- **Nine board tests passed:** XDC byte preservation and port coverage; 17 real lab elaborations in each of four configurations; TM1638 options; complete video frames; microphone samples and DAC words/rates; reset/buttons; GPIO/UART. The final clock-constraint and top-port checks were rerun after restoring the clock declaration and passed.
- The GPIO test exercises each available bit at both logic levels in both directions, followed by high-impedance release. Its eight scenarios cover all four configurations with accessories active and disabled: **35, 38 or 44 usable pins**, as applicable. No-TM1638 elaborations exclude the actual controller source to detect accidental instantiation.
- **22 board-menu tests passed**, covering 117 configurations across 54 board groups. **44 desktop/mobile browser views passed** for both guide languages and the updated review appendices. All 88 local links checked in six current HTML documents resolve, and guide regeneration is idempotent. The prompt archives include the exact GPIO request as P36 with its Russian translation.

Run the regressions from the repository root:

```bash
python3 -B scripts/tests/test_cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex.py
python3 -B scripts/tests/test_board_menu.py
```

## Vivado 2026.1 builds

All four builds completed synthesis, placement, routing and bitstream generation for `xc7a35tcpg236-1`. Each routed I/O report was independently checked against the XDC: all 62 ports have the correct package pin and LVCMOS33 standard, and all 44 DIP ports are bidirectional. No-PLL builds contain zero PLL/MMCM cells; no-TM1638 builds contain no TM1638 controller. No design has unclocked registers or unconstrained internal endpoints.

| Configuration | Lab | Setup WNS | Hold WHS | DRC errors |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 MHz, TM1638 | Rectangle / ellipse / parabola | +5.095 ns | +0.131 ns | 0 |
| 12 MHz, TM1638 | Microphone monitor | +70.596 ns | +0.114 ns | 0 |
| 100 MHz, no TM1638 | Rectangle / ellipse / parabola | +5.654 ns | +0.131 ns | 0 |
| 12 MHz, no TM1638 | Microphone monitor | +73.030 ns | +0.117 ns | 0 |

These timing margins cover constrained FPGA paths. The manufacturer XDC leaves external I/O delays unspecified. DRC retains CFGBVS-1 (configuration-voltage properties unspecified), and RPBF-3 for accessory ports whose current lab uses only input or only output buffering despite their generic `inout` declarations. The graphics builds also retain DSP pipelining recommendations. No DRC error or critical warning was suppressed.

**No physical board was programmed or tested.** Electrical operation, external timing, monitor acceptance and audio playback still need hardware validation. Earlier November 16–17 bitstreams predate this GPIO expansion.

To reproduce a build, run Vivado from a fresh output directory, substituting the checkout path and one of the four configuration names:

```bash
vivado -mode batch -source /path/to/basics-graphics-music/scripts/tests/build_cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex.tcl \
    -tclargs labs/3_music/3_11_microphone_monitor cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_no_pll_codex
```

The driver checks the input clock and GPIO ports, writes timing/clock/I/O/DRC/utilization reports and a routed checkpoint, and stops if constrained setup/hold timing is absent or fails. It creates a bitstream without programming hardware.
